recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, symmetrical composite portrait where two distinct male faces are merged down the center line, set against a dark, stormy sky. A vertical wisp of blue-tinted smoke bisects the face, while heavy metallic typography anchors the bottom of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right halves of the composite face
Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cold blue smoke
Dominance of the large metallic title against the dark background
Atmospheric depth created by low-lying clouds and a dark horizon
coreInvariants: Vertical bisection of the central subject
Low-key lighting with strong highlights on facial contours
Brushed metal texture on the primary display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The composite head is centered and scaled to fill the upper two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, wide-set metallic title at the bottom provides a heavy horizontal base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central smoke line, moves outward to the eyes, then drops down to the bold title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space in the upper corners and around the head emphasizes the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark charcoal for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and brown skin tones for the central portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated cyan/blue for the smoke and silver-grey for the metallic text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, focusing on texture and form over color.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar or uses a low-slung geometric bar
The 'F' and 'E' have long horizontal arms

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the base, sitting over a dark cloud layer

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity through width; both display and metadata fonts share an ultra-wide geometric DNA.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line above the main title
Smoke trail acting as a vertical axis

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, wide geometric aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary square-off corners and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A composite portrait of two men merged vertically down the center. The lighting is dramatic and low-key. A thin wisp of blue smoke rises vertically between the eyes. The background is a dark, moody sky with low-lying clouds at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-wide geometric sans-serif text at the bottom in a brushed metal style with a bevel effect. Place smaller, wide-tracked white text in the top corners.

verificationChecks: Is the face perfectly bisected by the smoke?
Does the bottom text have a convincing metallic texture?
Is the lighting consistent across both halves of the face?
Is the background sufficiently dark to make the white text legible?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the two facial halves
avoid: Harsh, unblended seams in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical alignment of the nose and lips
Ensure the metallic bevel doesn't look like a simple drop shadow
Verify the smoke doesn't obscure the eyes too much
Confirm the 'metadata' text is legible against the dark sky
recipe.reuseFormula: Composite portrait + vertical smoke axis + ultra-wide metallic geometric typography + low-key stormy background.
